doc: Edge detection on the luma (Rec.709) of the premultiplied colour, 3x3 neighbourhood (one value for all channels). sobel: e = sqrt(gx^2+gy^2)/4; laplacian: e = |8c - sum of the 8 neighbours|/4. e = clamp(e * strength); values below threshold become 0. mode 'edges': straight grey = e (invert: 1 - e); mode 'overlay': straight colour = original + e (invert: original - e). Alpha unchanged.

threshold.doc: edge values below this become 0 (applied after strength)
